brief: An Android messenger with a playful educational cipher mode and ordinary chat, upfront about what is and is not secure. Honest, clever, friendly, trustworthy.
criteria: Distinct from padlock/shield/bubble-icon messengers, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, friendly but credible.

concepts.name: Twin Bubbles
concepts.idea: Two chat bubbles, one rotated 180 degrees about the other: ROT13 as a shape. Apply it twice and you get yourself back.
rationale: Not a padlock, shield or bubble-plus-icon: a chat mark that is also a cipher idea
One construction (circle + one sharp corner), rotated once; the overlap is a real hole
The i in the wordmark reuses the bubble, tying symbol and name together
Emerald on charcoal (8.9:1) in the app; Deep Emerald on light (5.3:1)

recommendation: Use Twin Bubbles as the app icon (emerald on charcoal), with the horizontal lockup in headers and the stacked lockup for store and social.
